name: css-craft
description: Portable design skill behavior and routing checks

scenarios.name: focused CSS defect
scenarios.prompt: A long title overflows its card at 320px in an existing web app. Explain the diagnostic and verification path only; do not edit files. Read `.claude/skills/css-craft/SKILL.md` and its relevant reference first.

judge: For this explanation-only request, the response names plausible intrinsic-size or container causes to inspect, gives a focused verification path for the 320px long-title case, and does not claim a cause or rendered result without inspecting the app. It does not launch visual boards or a global reset.

scenarios.name: browser-aware technique
scenarios.prompt: We want to use a new CSS feature for an animated accordion. Explain the technique choice and proof, including support and reduced motion. Do not edit files. Read `.claude/skills/css-craft/SKILL.md` first.

judge: For this explanation-only request, the response directs a current support check against primary platform documentation before implementation, plans a fallback and checks for state, keyboard use and reduced motion, and does not claim browser proof it did not perform.
